title: Community and Premium-Class Caps on Open Homesite Reservations
content:
**Clause.** Across a buyer's open Homesite Reservations (status pending deposit or held), no community may carry more than the maximum active reservations per buyer in one community of the class being reserved, and at most **1** of them may be a Greenbelt Homesite, Water-View Homesite or Golf-Frontage Homesite. The check is made on the portfolio as it would stand after the write, so a swap into a community where the buyer already holds a homesite, or a second premium-class hold, is refused, while a swap that leaves the counts unchanged is allowed. Reinstating an expired hold counts as opening it again. The buyer's open reservations must leave room under these caps for the new or moved homesite.

## Scope

The clause applies to three writes: a new reservation, a swap of a reservation to another homesite, and the reinstatement of an expired hold. It is judged from the buyer's reservation records (community, premium class and status of each), not from the buyer's statements.

## Premium classes for the second cap

Greenbelt Homesite, Water-View Homesite and Golf-Frontage Homesite. Interior Homesite, Corner Homesite and Cul-de-Sac Homesite reservations are not counted toward this cap.

## Truth table (portfolio after the write)

| Open reservations in the target community after the write within the class maximum | Open premium-class reservations after the write at most 1 | Write |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | allowed |
| Yes | No | refused |
| No | Yes | refused |
| No | No | refused |

## Illustrations (hypothetical portfolios)

- A buyer holds a Corner Homesite in one community and asks to swap it to another homesite in the same community: the counts after the swap are unchanged, so the swap is allowed.
- A buyer holds a Greenbelt Homesite in one community and asks to reserve a Water-View Homesite in a different community: the premium-class count after the write would be 2, so the reservation is refused.
- A buyer holds a held Interior Homesite in one community and has an expired Cul-de-Sac Homesite in a different community: reinstating the expired hold opens it again, leaving one open reservation in each community and none in a premium class, so the caps leave room.
